name: scholar-workflow-bridge
description: Zotero plugin that exposes a restricted local HTTP API for scholar-workflow writes
author: Scholar Workflow contributors
notes: Token is generated at install time and stored in Zotero preferences.
All write operations call Zotero JS API with saveTx(); never write SQLite directly.
ZotMoov integration is attempted after item creation if ZotMoov is installed.
Partial failures return structured phase status for Saga recovery.
